about.title: About VigyanShaala
about.subtitle: Empowering learners worldwide with quality education and practical skills
about.whoWeAre.heading: Transforming Education, One Learner at a Time
about.whoWeAre.description1: VigyanShaala was founded with a simple mission: to make quality education accessible to everyone. We believe that knowledge should have no boundaries, and every individual deserves the opportunity to learn and grow.
about.whoWeAre.description2: Our platform brings together world-class instructors, cutting-edge technology, and a supportive community to create an unparalleled learning experience. Whether you're looking to start a new career, upgrade your skills, or explore new interests, VigyanShaala is here to guide you on your journey.

about.mission.heading: Our Mission
about.mission.text: To democratize education by providing accessible, high-quality learning experiences that empower individuals to achieve their personal and professional goals. We strive to bridge the gap between traditional education and the skills demanded by the modern workforce.
about.vision.heading: Our Vision
about.vision.text: To become the world's most trusted and impactful online learning platform, where anyone, anywhere can access the education they need to transform their lives. We envision a future where learning knows no boundaries and opportunity is truly equal.

home.testimonials.heading: What Our Students Say
home.testimonials.subheading: Real stories from real learners who have achieved success with VigyanShaala
home.testimonials.item1.quote: Darshana di has been a constant source of motivation for me and we have been in touch from Kalpana SHE for STEM (2023). I cannot express in words how much my life has changed since then.
home.testimonials.item1.name: Gauri Patti
home.testimonials.item1.role: Ph.D. Student, Astrophysics, University of Leeds
home.testimonials.item2.quote: VigyanShaala’s She for STEM and STEM Champions programs gave me the financial security and supportive network to thrive both personally and professionally. Along this journey, I have learned immensely from my peers and mentors, whose guidance and collaboration strengthened my confidence and opened doors to growth. This community continues to inspire resilience, purpose, and empowerment in my STEM path.
home.testimonials.item2.name: Diksha Nagarkoti
home.testimonials.item2.role: Master’s Student, Ashoka Trust for Research in Ecology and the Environment (ATREE)
home.testimonials.item3.name: Nikita Tiwari
home.testimonials.item3.role: M.Sc.(Tech) Engineering Physics, National Institute of Technology, Warangal
home.testimonials.item4.quote: When I became a Kalpana fellow during the second year of my bachelor's at kumaun University Nainital, I received personalized mentoring from incredible mentors. My mentors especially Darshana di and Anushila di, not only just guided me in my field of interest but they went beyond their way to help me find and apply for exciting academic opportunities. The program equipped me with skills like building a strong networking profile, even applying for positions that once I thought were beyond my reach.
home.testimonials.item4.name: Garima
home.testimonials.item4.role: Senior Associate, the Center for BioPharma Analysis (CBA) at Venture Center
home.testimonials.item5.quote: I have been part of Vigyanshaala's Kalpana SHE for STEM programme since December, 2023. The incubator phase helped me explore my career opportunities while the accelerator phase not only helped me gain industry insights through the SUKs but also manifest my interests into a real project. My accelerator mentor, Mr. Raj Ramanatha sir provided significant guidance, not only with respect to my technical project but also with respect to personality development, throughout the weekly meetings. I am grateful for this wonderful programme by VigyanShaala that has helped me nurture my all-round personality!
home.testimonials.item5.name: Abha Barge
home.testimonials.item5.role: B.Tech. student in Computer Engineering, MKSSS Cummins College of Engineering for Women
home.testimonials.item6.quote: I’ve always been passionate about protecting nature and wildlife, and I’m committed to making a positive impact in this field. Vigyanshaala has played a huge role in supporting me on this path. Since becoming a Vigyanshaala STEM Fellow in 2022, I’ve received constant guidance and encouragement. The Kalpana programme, in particular, has been a key source of inspiration and learning for me.  I owe a very special part of this journey to VigyanShaala International. Without their unwavering support, mentorship, and the fully funded scholarship, this dream would not have been possible. Their belief in me changed the course of my life.
home.testimonials.item6.name: Himani Upadhyay
home.testimonials.item6.role: Master’s in Environment and Resource Management, TERI, Awareness Program Officer, The Corbett Foundation
